overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs DCT Premier Edition 0.8 HP Cold/Heat System with WIFI App is a versatile solution for maintaining optimal water temperatures in plunges up to 135 gallons. Suitable for installation in fitness rooms or home spas, this system is designed for easy setup with quick connect hoses and a splash-proof digital touch screen.
